page.title: Pending sync
page.description: Work saved on this device that the server has not confirmed yet. It is sent in the order you did it.
page.offlineNotice: You're offline. Saved work will be sent automatically when the connection returns.
page.memoryOnly: This browser can't keep offline work after a reload. Stay online until everything is synced.
page.loadError: This device couldn't open its offline storage. Keep the app online and reload the page.
page.empty: Nothing is waiting. Everything saved on this device is synced.
page.unsynced: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing waiting} one {# item not synced yet} other {# items not synced yet}}

item.attempts: {count, plural, =0 {Not sent yet} one {# attempt} other {# attempts}}
item.staleHelp: This was saved more than 7 days ago, so it is not sent automatically. Check it is still correct, then send it or discard it.
item.replayed: The server already had this; nothing was applied twice.

actions.confirmDiscard: Discard this item? It will not be sent and can't be recovered.

report.result: {done, plural, =0 {Nothing new was sent.} one {# item synced.} other {# items synced.}}
report.attention: {count, plural, one {# item needs your attention.} other {# items need your attention.}}
report.interrupted: The connection dropped. The rest will be sent automatically.
report.offline: You're offline. Try again when you're connected.
report.busy: Another tab is syncing. This list updates when it finishes.
report.error: Sync couldn't run on this device. Reload the page and try again.

conflict.title: Someone else changed this record
conflict.help: Compare the server's values with yours. Send yours to overwrite the server, or discard yours.
conflict.caption: Server values compared with yours
conflict.noDetails: The server didn't send details. Reload the record to see its latest values, then retry or discard.

codes.NO_SENDER: This version of the app can't send this item. Reload the app while online.
codes.STALE: Saved more than 7 days ago; review it before sending.
codes.NO_EMPLOYEE_PROFILE: Your account isn't linked to an employee profile. Ask an admin.
codes.DUPLICATE_CUSTOMER: A customer with this phone number already exists.
codes.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This item's reference was already used for a different record.
codes.WORKFLOW_MISSING: No approval workflow is set up for this. Ask an admin.
